title: Jazzy Fluffy Kenyan Milk Pancakes
description: Fluffy and kid-friendly Kenyan pancakes made with semi-skimmed milk and a hint of char-grill flavor, perfect for a tasty breakfast or snack. This recipe is jain-friendly and features a unique blend of spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and char-grill yang powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the semi-skimmed milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
The batter should still be slightly lumpy, with a few streaks of flour remaining.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and grease with a small amount of oil or cooking spray.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with your favorite toppings, such as fresh fruit, whipped cream, or maple syrup.
